title: DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corporation (Nasdaq: DTSQ) filed an 8-K on April 9, 2026 disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency letter dated April 6, 2026. The letter notifies the company that it fails to meet Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(2), which requires at least 400 total public holders for continued listing on the Nasdaq Global Market. The deficiency letter does not constitute an immediate delisting notice and has no current effect on trading. The company has until May 21, 2026 to submit a compliance plan.
key_points: On April 6, 2026, Nasdaq notified DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corporation of non-compliance with Listing Rule 5450(a)(2), the Minimum Public Holders Rule (minimum 400 total holders).
The deficiency finding was based on a shareholder range analysis provided by the company to Nasdaq dated March 27, 2026.
The deficiency letter is not a notice of imminent delisting and has no current effect on the listing or trading of the company's securities.
The company has 45 calendar days (until May 21, 2026) to submit a plan to regain compliance.
If Nasdaq accepts the plan, an extension of up to 180 calendar days from the deficiency letter date may be granted.
The company may also consider applying for a transfer to The Nasdaq Capital Market if it cannot regain compliance on the Global Market.
why_it_matters: This filing is relevant only at the single-issuer level for a small SPAC (DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corporation). It has no broader market structure or macro significance. Investors holding DTSQ, DTSQR, or DTSQU should be aware of potential delisting risk if compliance is not restored.
market_structure_context: Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(2) requires a minimum of 400 total public holders for continued listing on the Nasdaq Global Market. Failure to meet this threshold triggers a formal deficiency process with defined cure periods and appeal rights. Transfer to the Nasdaq Capital Market is a permitted alternative pathway.
important_numbers: 400 — minimum total holders required under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(2)
45 calendar days — deadline to submit compliance plan (by May 21, 2026)
180 calendar days — maximum extension Nasdaq may grant from the deficiency letter date
1/9 — fraction of one ordinary share each right entitles the holder to receive
